summary: Mixed legacy VB6 patterns with modern Python agent architecture. VB6 follows Hungarian notation and event-driven patterns, while Python follows PEP8 and class-based agent design.

rules.rule: VB6 controls use Hungarian notation prefixes (frm, txt, cmd, lbl)
Forms are MDI children with maximized window state
Agent classes follow PascalCase with 'Agent' suffix
Use relative imports for agent modules within package

lint_recommendations: Implement VB6 to C# naming convention mapping for modernization
Add validation for Hungarian notation consistency in legacy code
Enforce PEP8 compliance for Python agent modules
Add type hints to Python agent classes and methods
scaffold_templates: ASP.NET Core Razor Page template for VB6 form conversion
Entity Framework model template for ADO data access conversion
Bootstrap UI component templates for VB6 control mapping
Authentication middleware template for VB6 login form replacement
